statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ U V : ℕ, 2≤U → (∑ n ∈ (Finset.range V).filter (fun n => U<n+2 ∧ (¬n.Prime ∨ ¬(n+2).Prime)), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2)/(n+2 : ℝ)) ≤ C*Real.log (2+U)/Real.sqrt U

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 非双素数的调和尾项
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Bound the harmonic tail from nonprime endpoints

brief.zh: 证明 $\sum_{n+2>U,\ (n,n+2)\text{非双素}}\Lambda(n)\Lambda(n+2)/(n+2)\ll\log(2+U)/\sqrt U$，$U\ge2$。由 `square-log-mass`、`higher-power-log-mass` 在 $[V,2V]$ 上分别计两端，另一端权至多 $\log(2V+2)$，再取 $V=2^jU$ 求和。
brief.en: Count prime squares and higher powers on dyadic blocks and sum the weighted bounds.
